title: Runner compiles C for RISC-V and returns image plus line map (/explain)
description:
As the explorer, I need a server endpoint that compiles untrusted C for RV32IM bare metal and returns a program image and instruction-to-line mapping.

Feature: Explain endpoint
  Scenario: Hello world
    Given a C hello world
    When it is sent to /explain
    Then a program image and instruction list are returned with every executable line mapped
  Scenario: Hostile compile-time input
    Given source that includes an infinite file
    Then the request ends with a limit status and the runner stays healthy
right_now_summary: The team is building an endpoint that compiles untrusted C and returns code with source-line mappings.
